arxiv-2011-08909.title: C-Learning: Learning to Achieve Goals via Recursive Classification
arxiv-2011-08909.creator: Benjamin Eysenbach, Ruslan Salakhutdinov, Sergey Levine
arxiv-2011-08909.description: Abstract We study the problem of predicting and controlling the future state distribution of an autonomous agent. This problem, which can be viewed as a reframing of goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (RL), is centered around learning a conditional probability density function over future states.

arxiv-2106-00953.title: Convergence analysis of a Lagrangian numerical scheme in computing effective diffusivity of 3D time-dependent flows
arxiv-2106-00953.creator: Zhongjian Wang, Jack Xin, Zhiwen Zhang
arxiv-2106-00953.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Zhongjian Wang, Jack Xin, Zhiwen Zhang. In this paper, we study the convergence analysis for a robust stochastic structure-preserving Lagrangian numerical scheme in computing effective diffusivity of time-dependent chaotic flows, which are modeled by stochastic differential equations (SDEs). Our numerical scheme is based on a splitting method to solve the corresponding SDEs in which the deterministic subproblem is discretized using structure-preserving schemes while the random subproblem is discretized using the Euler-Maruyama scheme.

arxiv-2303-00756.title: Density-matrix-renormalization-group-based downfolding of the three-band Hubbard model: the importance of density-assisted hopping
arxiv-2303-00756.creator: Shengtao Jiang (gbsn蒋晟韬), Douglas J. Scalapino, Steven R. White
arxiv-2303-00756.description: Abstract Typical Wannier-function downfolding starts with a mean-field or density functional set of bands to construct the Wannier functions. Here we carry out a controlled approach, using DMRG-computed natural orbital bands, to downfold the three-band Hubbard model to an effective single band model.

arxiv-2312-14153.title: New Constraints on Axion-Like Particles from IXPE Polarization Data for Magnetars
arxiv-2312-14153.creator: Kuver Sinha
arxiv-2312-14153.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Kuver Sinha. We derive new constraints on axion-like particles (ALPs) using precision X X -ray polarization studies of magnetars. Specifically, we use the first detection of polarized X X -rays from the magnetars 4U 0142+61 and 1RXS J170849.0-400910 by the Imaging X X -ray Polarimetry Explorer (IXPE) to place bounds on the product of the ALP-photon and ALP-nucleon couplings, g a ​ γ ​ g a ​ N g_{a\gamma}g_{aN} , with g a ​ N g_{aN} being responsible for ALP production in the core

arxiv-2403-09697.title: A Short Note on the Infinity Product Tan (z) Function
arxiv-2403-09697.creator: Carlos A. Pérez Aparicio
arxiv-2403-09697.description: Abstract 1 COITIRM, Independent Researcher. Email: cperapa@gmail.com Abstract:We present a novel derivation of the infinite product of the tangent function, Tan(z), expressed in terms of trigonometric expressions including Euler’s Sinc function and Viète’s formula, along with their generalizations. Mathematics Subject Classifications: 33-01, 33-02, 33-04, 33-02,40A20 Key Words and Phrases: Viète’s formula, tan function 1.

arxiv-2403-12275.title: Fast and accurate nonadiabatic molecular dynamics enabled through variational interpolation of correlated electron wavefunctions
arxiv-2403-12275.creator: Kemal Atalar, Yannic Rath, Rachel Crespo-Otero, George H. Booth
arxiv-2403-12275.description: Abstract We build on the concept of eigenvector continuation to develop an efficient multi-state method for the rigorous and smooth interpolation of a small training set of many-body wavefunctions through chemical space at mean-field cost. The inferred states are represented as variationally optimal linear combinations of the training states transferred between the many-body basis of different nuclear geometries.

arxiv-2405-14749.title: Policy Gradient Methods for Risk-Sensitive Distributional Reinforcement Learning with Provable Convergence
arxiv-2405-14749.creator: Minheng Xiao Xian Yu and Lei Ying
arxiv-2405-14749.description: Abstract Risk-sensitive reinforcement learning (RL) is crucial for maintaining reliable performance in high-stakes applications. While traditional RL methods aim to learn a point estimate of the random cumulative cost, distributional RL (DRL) seeks to estimate the entire distribution of it, which leads to a unified framework for handling different risk measures ( Bellemare et al. 2017 ) .

arxiv-2407-05877.title: Effect of nonmagnetic Ti substitution on the structural, magnetic and transport properties in pyrochlore iridate Eu 2 (Ir 1-x Ti x ) 2 O 7
arxiv-2407-05877.creator: Sampad Mondal a,b,c , B. Maji d , M. Modak b , Swapan K. Mandal a and S. Banerjee b
arxiv-2407-05877.description: Abstract We have studied the effect of nonmagnetic Ti substitution Eu 2 (Ir 1-x Ti x ) 2 O 7 with the help of electrical transport and magnetic measurement. The minor structural modification enhances the orbital overlapping and favours its electrical transport properties with Ti doping though the tuning of SOC and U with site dilution opposes it.

arxiv-2409-05488.title: Mesoscopic light transport in nonlinear disordered media
arxiv-2409-05488.creator: Alfonso Nardi, Andrea Morandi, Romain Pierrat, Arthur Goetschy, Xuanchen Li, Frank Scheffold, Rachel Grange
arxiv-2409-05488.description: Abstract Nonlinear disordered media uniquely combine multiple scattering and second-harmonic generation. Here, we investigate the statistical properties of the nonlinear light generated within such media. We report super-Rayleigh statistics of the second-harmonic speckle intensity, and demonstrate that it is caused by the mesoscopic correlations arising in extreme scattering conditions.

arxiv-2410-18361.title: Phase Behaviour of X-Shaped Liquid Crystalline Molecules
arxiv-2410-18361.creator: Dan Wei, Zhijuan He, Yunqing Huang, An-Chang Shi, Kai Jiang
arxiv-2410-18361.description: Abstract X-shaped liquid crystalline molecules (XLCMs) are obtained by tethering two flexible end A-blocks and two flexible side B-blocks to a rigid backbone (R). A rich array of ordered structures can be formed from XLCMs, driven by the competition between the interactions between the chemically distinct blocks and the molecular connectivity.

arxiv-2509-01584.title: ViSTA-SLAM: Visual SLAM with Symmetric Two-view Association
arxiv-2509-01584.creator: Ganlin Zhang, Shenhan Qian, Xi Wang, Daniel Cremers
arxiv-2509-01584.description: Abstract We present ViSTA-SLAM as a real-time monocular visual SLAM system that operates without requiring camera intrinsics, making it broadly applicable across diverse camera setups. At its core, the system employs a lightweight symmetric two-view association (STA) model as the frontend, which simultaneously estimates relative camera poses and regresses local pointmaps from only two RGB images.

plos-pone-0006589.creator: Biaoyang Lin, Jun Wang, Xu Hong et al.
plos-pone-0006589.description: PLOS ONE research article. The androgen receptor (AR) plays important roles in the development of male phenotype and in different human diseases including prostate cancers. The AR can act either as a promoter or a tumor suppressor depending on cell types. The AR proliferative response program has been well

pmc-10716848.title: Diversity of parasitoid wasps (Insecta, Hymenoptera) in oilseed rape fields in Serbia
pmc-10716848.creator: Milan Plećaš, Vladimir Žikić, Korana Kocić, Jelisaveta Čkrkić, Anđeljko Petrović, Željko Tomanović
pmc-10716848.description: BackgroundOilseed rape is an important crop grown worldwide and used for various purposes, including oil extraction and animal feed. In Europe, there are six major pest species and several other minor pests that can significantly affect oilseed rape production, requiring growers to effectively control them in order to ensure crop yield.

pmc-11387573.title: Uncertainty and Fertility in Ukraine on the Eve of Russia’s Full-Scale Invasion: The Impact of Armed Conflict and Economic Crisis
pmc-11387573.creator: Brienna Perelli-Harris, Theodore Gerber, Yuliya Hilevych
pmc-11387573.description: While uncertainty has been a key explanation for very low fertility throughout Europe, few studies have analysed how macro-level uncertainty trickles down to shape how people think about having children. Most research focuses on economic uncertainty, not political or social uncertainty.

pmc-11445044.title: Cytomegalovirus results in poor graft function via bone marrow-derived endothelial progenitor cells
pmc-11445044.creator: Weiran Lv, Ya Zhou, Ke Zhao, Li Xuan, Fen Huang, Zhiping Fan, Yuan Chang, Zhengshan Yi, Hua Jin, Yang Liang, Qifa Liu
pmc-11445044.description: IntroductionPoor graft function (PGF), characterized by myelosuppression, represents a significant challenge following allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (allo-HSCT) with human cytomegalovirus (HCMV) being established as a risk factor for PGF. However, the underlying mechanism remains unclear. Bone marrow endothelial progenitor cells (BM-EPCs) play an important role in supporting hematopoiesis and their dysfunction contributes to PGF development.

pmc-11487921.title: Risk factors for Pseudomonas aeruginosa isolation in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11487921.creator: Yuyu Zhang, Nini Zhang, Tingting Li, Lanrui Jing, Yu Wang, Wei Ge
pmc-11487921.description: BackgroundPseudomonas aeruginosa (PA) isolation in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) has been associated with a poor prognosis. This meta-analysis aimed to determine significant risk factors for PA isolation among patients with COPD.MethodsA systematic literature retrieval from PubMed, Embase, Web of Science and China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI) was conducted, including studies from January 2003 to September 2024.

pmc-11536096.title: CXCL13 promotes broad immune responses induced by circular RNA vaccines
pmc-11536096.creator: Jiawu Wan, Caiqian Wang, Zongmei Wang, Lingli Wang, Haoran Wang, Ming Zhou, Zhen F. Fu, Ling Zhao
pmc-11536096.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). SignificanceIntegrating adjuvants into circular RNAs (circRNAs) demonstrates the prospect of developing circRNA vaccines and adjuvants, enabling circRNA encoding antigens and adjuvants can codeliver both components to the same antigen-presenting cell in a straightforward formulation. Here, we designed a general strategy to improve the magnitude and breadth of the antibody response induced by circRNA vaccines and remodeled the immune microenvironment of lymph nodes by integrating CXCL13 and antigens into circRNAs for coexpression.

pmc-11664353.title: Social, cultural and political conditions for advancing health equity: examples from eight country case studies (2011–2021)
pmc-11664353.creator: Miriam van den Berg, Joanne Flavel, Ashley Schram, Sharon Friel, Hailay Abrha Gesesew, Fran Baum
pmc-11664353.description: Progress in addressing systematic health inequities, both between and within countries, has been slow. However, there are examples of actions taken on social determinants of health and policy changes aimed at shaping the underlying sociopolitical context that drives these inequities.

pmc-12395681.title: Wealth, income and dementia in Germany: longitudinal findings from a representative survey among the oldest old
pmc-12395681.creator: André Hajek, Hans-Helmut König, Snorri Bjorn Rafnsson, Razak M Gyasi
pmc-12395681.description: BackgroundThere is limited knowledge on the link between wealth, as well as income, and dementia risk among the oldest old (80 years and over). The purpose of our study was to examine the association between income, wealth, and dementia among the oldest old in Germany.

pmc-12587495.title: Association of the American heart association’s new “life’s essential 8" cardiovascular health with all-cause and cardiovascular mortality in adults with and without cancer: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-12587495.creator: Shixuan Peng, Qisheng Chen, Qianzi Liu, Ruijie Xie, Yongjun Wu
pmc-12587495.description: BackgroundThe American Heart Association released an updated algorithm used to assess cardiovascular health (CVH)-the Life’s Essential 8 (LE8) score. Our objective was to quantify the association between CVH levels estimated by the LE8 score and all-cause and cardiovascular mortality in adults with and without cancer.

pmc-12643304.title: Aging and episodic memory specificity: Evidence challenging a domain-general pattern separation decline
pmc-12643304.creator: Ariana Youm, Melanie Cohn, Katherine Duncan, Jie Wang, Jie Wang, Jie Wang, Jie Wang
pmc-12643304.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Aging is associated with a decline in episodic memory specificity. This phenomenon has been observed across various memory tasks, such as the Mnemonic Similarity Task (MST), where older adults show a heightened tendency to falsely recognize perceptually similar items. While many studies suggest this impairment reflects a generalized reduction in pattern separation, others indicate that older adults may exhibit preserved discrimination abilities for semantic representations.

pmc-12654357.title: Synthesis, Structure and Dielectric Characteristics of Tellurovanadate Glasses Containing Bismuth Oxide
pmc-12654357.creator: Tina Tasheva, Stanislav Slavov, Philippe Colomban, Fabrizio Roccaforte
pmc-12654357.description: Two series of glasses with compositions (90 − x)TeO2-xV2O5-10Bi2O3 and (80 − x)TeO2-xV2O5-20Bi2O3, where x = 20, 30, 40 mol %, were synthesized. Glasses were obtained by the melt-quenching technique. The molar volume (33.48–48.37 cm3/mol) and oxygen packing density (71.69–77.64 mol/cm3) were calculated based on experimental density measurements.

pmc-13173585.title: Nodulo-Infiltrative Subtype of Basal Cell Carcinoma With Follicular and Sebaceous Differentiation
pmc-13173585.creator: Alyssa M Iurillo, Brian Chu, David Pomerantz, Jaclyn Anderson, Leslie Robinson-Bostom
pmc-13173585.description: Basal cell carcinoma (BCC) is the most common cancer and typically presents as a slow-growing pearly papule with telangiectasias on sun-damaged skin, particularly the head and neck.Although BCC metastasizes rarely, delayed treatment can lead to significant local tissue destruction. Common subtypes of BCC include nodular, micronodular, superficial, and infiltrative. Rarer variants with sebaceous or follicular differentiation have also been reported.

pmc-13329038.title: Nanoparticle-Based Antigen Delivery: Advancing Immunization Strategies against Infectious Pathogens
pmc-13329038.creator: Surajit Patra, Nida Irfan Pathan, Yogesh A. Karpe, Virendra Gajbhiye
pmc-13329038.description: Stimulation of adaptive immunity is a goal to defend against infectious agents. In recent years, vaccine development and improvements in their efficacy have been thoroughly investigated, and highly effective vaccines have been released to the market. The administration of vaccinations, safety, and the development of immunogenicity pose considerable challenges in this area.

pmc-13348761.title: Calpain cleaves the distal carboxyl terminus of TRPV1 and modulates its tachyphylaxis
pmc-13348761.creator: Jin-Yan Jiang, Xiao-Chen Wang, Jing Yang, Shu-Wen Gao, Ji-Xuan Xu, Mu-Lan Chen, Zhong-Zhe Zhang, Jiao Liu, Yun Wang, Ping Liang, Ying Zhang
pmc-13348761.description: BackgroundTransient receptor potential vanilloid-1 (TRPV1) plays a critical role in noxious heat sensation in physiological conditions and pain hypersensitivity in pathological pain. Capsaicin, a classic TRPV1 agonist, is used to relieve pain partially through induction of TRPV1 desensitization. Multiple mechanisms have been proposed to contribute to TRPV1 desensitization.

pmc-13522693.creator: Ying H Luu, Hamid R Hajmomenian, Reza Khorsan

pmc-13615175.title: A Prolonged Case of Mucocutaneous Leishmaniasis in a Central American Patient
pmc-13615175.creator: Mario M Diaz Moreno, Graciamaria Alvarenga Somoza, Casto D Ramirez Dominguez
pmc-13615175.description: Mucocutaneous leishmaniasis (MCL) is a parasitic infection transmitted through sand fly bites. This disease affects people who are living in or traveling to endemic regions around the world. Cases of MCL remain underreported due to its clinical presentation and potential misdiagnosis, with cases in older adults rarely described in the literature.
